title: Report - New Commissioner Of Public Safety Appointed

page_data.en:
JAN 11 1932
1580 COMMISSIONER OF POLICE
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. D. REGISTRY
B. D. 9054
19. 1. 32.

COPY

Translation of despatch No. 14 to Chairman
from the Bureau of Public Safety.
Dated 9th January, 1932.

----

New Commissioner of Public Safety appointed.

Order No. 2, Municipality of Greater Shanghai, notifies
appointment of Wen Ying-hsing(溫 應 星) as Commissioner
of the Bureau of Public Safety.

The Commissioner assumed charge of the official seal
and the office on the 8th instant. The oath of office will be
taken at a later date. The Chairman of the Council is hereby
informed of the change.

(Signed) Wen Ying-hsing
Commissioner.

Chien.
11 JAN. 1932

page_data.en:
Wu To Assume Authority
As New Mayor Here Today

West Point Man To Head Police; Chang Chun
Entertains For Successor

General Wu Te-cheng, new mayor of Shanghai, will assume office tomorrow morning at 9 o'clock, Mr. O. K. Yui, chief secretary at the office of the mayor during General Chang Chun's administration, agreed to carry on for the present as a result of the repeated urging of his new chief.

General Wen Ying-hsin, a graduate of West Point Military Academy, will be appointed director of the Bureau of Public Safety according to the decision of General Wu. General Wen was former chief of police of Harbin, former assistant chief of staff to the military governors of Kiangsu and Kwangtung. He will resign his present position as commander of the Nanking gendarmes to accept the new appointment.

Chang Chun Honors Wu
Assurance that the constructive plans of his predecessor would be faithfully carried out was pledged by General Wu Te-cheng, new mayor of Shanghai, at a banquet given by General Chang Chun, the retiring mayor, at the Chinese Bankers' Club last night to more than 50 prominent local leaders.

The object of General Chang's banquet to these leaders of industry and commerce, education and journalism was to thank them for the support he received from them during his administration and to introduce the new mayor and ask them to accord to his successor the same amount of cooperation.

General Chang said in an after-dinner speech that after having been mayor of this city for two years and nine months he wished to bid his guests farewell. During the period he could not claim great achievements, but thanks for the cooperation of local leaders he was able to avoid making serious blunders, he added.

Praises Wu
"I wish to make use of this occasion to introduce to you a close friend of mine as my successor," the retiring mayor stated, "and on account of his education, his experience and his versatility on many subjects, General Wu Te-cheng is going to do much more for Shanghai than I have done."

General Chang then went on to give a brief account of General Wu's education and official career. The new mayor was educated in both Japan and the United States of America. On his return to China he held various important positions in Kwangtung and Nanking.

General Wu, responding, expressed his fear that he might not be worthy of the high opinions entertained by General Chang Chun. He himself had done all he could to persuade General Chang to change his mind to resign, now that he had resigned the

is, when a new official takes over an office the first thing he does is to destroy all the plans of his predecessor."

The second habit which General Wu mentioned as obnoxious is the change of the personnel of the old regime by the new regime. Unless these two habits are done away with, China cannot expect to make much progress, he said.

"General Chang has observed correctly that I regard myself as a native of Shanghai through my long residence", concluded General Wu, "and that may constitute an additional reason for me to exert my utmost in the interest of the city and to seek your continual support."

Other speakers of the evening were Mr. Yu Ya-ching, the shipping magnet; Mr. Hsu Shih-ying, director-general for famine relief;

and Mr. Wu Chi-kao, a well-known Ningpo merchant. All of them unanimously expressed regret for the retirement of General Chang and extended a cordial welcome to the new mayor.

吴氏今日在此就任新市长职权

西点军校毕业生将执掌警政；张群宴请继任者

上海新任市长吴铁城将军将于明日上午9时就职。在张群将军执政期间担任市长办公室首席秘书的余井塘先生，经新上司反复敦促，同意暂时留任。

根据吴将军的决定，西点军校毕业生温应星将军将被任命为公安局局长。温将军曾任哈尔滨警察厅长，江苏和广东督军的前参谋长助理。他将辞去现任南京宪兵司令一职，以接受新任命。

张群礼遇吴氏

上海新任市长吴铁城将军昨晚在中国银行家俱乐部举行的宴会上向50多位本地知名领袖保证，他将忠实执行前任的建设性计划。此次宴会由卸任市长张群将军举办。

张群将军宴请这些工商、教育和新闻界领袖的目的，是感谢他们在其任职期间给予的支持，并介绍新市长，请求他们给予继任者同样的合作。

张群将军在餐后致辞中表示，担任本市市长两年九个月后，他希望向宾客告别。他补充说，在此期间虽不敢称有巨大成就，但得益于本地领袖的合作，他得以避免犯下严重错误。

赞扬吴氏

卸任市长表示：“我想借此机会向各位介绍我的密友作为我的继任者，鉴于他的教育背景、经验以及在多方面事务上的多才多艺，吴铁城将军将为上海做出比我更多的贡献。”

随后，张群将军简要介绍了吴将军的教育背景和仕途经历。这位新市长曾在日本和美国接受教育。回国后，他在广东和南京担任过各种重要职务。

吴将军在答谢辞中表示，他担心自己可能配不上张群将军的高度评价。他说，为了劝说张群将军改变辞职的念头，他已竭尽全力，既然张将军已经辞职……

“即，当新官员接任职位时，他做的第一件事就是废除前任的所有计划。”

吴将军提到的第二个令人厌恶的习惯是新政权更换旧政权的人员。他说，除非消除这两种习惯，否则中国无法期待取得太大进步。

吴将军总结道：“张将军正确地观察到，由于长期居住，我视自己为上海人，这可能构成我为城市利益竭尽全力并寻求你们持续支持的额外理由。”

当晚的其他发言者包括航运巨头虞洽卿先生；赈灾委员会总干事许世英先生；

以及著名宁波商人吴季高先生。他们一致对张将军的离任表示遗憾，并向新市长表示热烈欢迎。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. L. REGISTRY S. S. B. D. 9054 Station, F. 1. 32. Date January 5, 1933.）

Subject (in full) Appointment of New Chief to the Public Safety Bureau.

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang. Forwarded by Jno Robertson, Supt

It is reported that General Wen Ying Sung (温应星), a
nephew of Mr. Wen Chung Yao (温宗尧), ex-Commissioner of
Foreign Affairs, will be appointed Chief of the Public
Safety Bureau.

Mr. Wen is a native of Canton, age about 35 and a
returned student from the West Point Military Academy,
U.S.A..

Mr. Wen joined the Anti-Smuggling Force under T.V.Soong
about 3 years ago. He was later made Commander of the
Force and has served in this capacity until recently when
he was succeeded by General Wong Keng (王赓).

It will be seen that General Wen is a follower of
Chiang Kai-shek's Clique and his appointment, if confirmed,
indicates that Chiang still possesses certain influence in
the Executive Yuan and that he has not forgotten the im-
portance of having a man of his own appointed to take charge
of the local police.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处及特别股登记处 S. S. B. D. 9054 分站，F. 1. 32. 日期 1933年1月5日。）

主题（全称）：公安局新任局长之任命。

由谭绍良警司制作。由警司 Jno Robertson 转发。

据报，前外交总长温宗尧先生的侄子温应星将军将被任命为公安局局长。

温先生是广东人，年龄约35岁，是美国西点军校归国留学生。

温先生大约3年前加入了宋子文领导的缉私队。后来他被任命为该队指挥官，并一直担任此职，直到最近由王赓将军接替。

由此可见，温将军是蒋介石派系的追随者，如果这一任命得到确认，表明蒋介石在行政院仍拥有一定的影响力，并且他没有忘记任命自己人来掌管地方警察的重要性。

谭绍良
警司。

特别股主管警官。
